description: Source code implementing the ClassType class in the ATen core library, managing class methods, hooks, attributes, constants, and type refinement within the PyTorch JIT framework.

classes.name: ClassType
classes.description: Represents a class type in the PyTorch JIT, managing methods, hooks, attributes, constants, and type refinement.

methods.name: addMethod
methods.description: Adds a method to the class type, ensuring no redefinition.

methods.name: getForwardHooks
methods.description: Returns the list of forward hooks.

methods.name: getForwardPreHooks
methods.description: Returns the list of forward pre-hooks.

methods.name: addForwardPreHook
methods.description: Adds a forward pre-hook.

methods.name: addForwardHook
methods.description: Adds a forward hook.

methods.name: findForwardPreHook
methods.description: Finds a forward pre-hook by name.

methods.name: findForwardHook
methods.description: Finds a forward hook by name.

methods.name: getSchemaInputTypesString
methods.description: Generates a string of input types from a function schema.

methods.name: getForwardPreHookErrorMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message for forward pre-hook scripting issues.

methods.name: getForwardHookErrorMessage
methods.description: Constructs an error message for forward hook scripting issues.

methods.name: isUnresolvedClassAttribute
methods.description: Checks if a class attribute is unresolved.

methods.name: checkForwardHookInputArguments
methods.description: Validates input arguments for forward hooks.

methods.name: checkForwardPreHookSchema
methods.description: Validates the schema of a forward pre-hook.

methods.name: checkForwardHookSchema
methods.description: Validates the schema of a forward hook.

methods.name: findMethod
methods.description: Finds a method by name.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Retrieves a method by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: findHook
methods.description: Finds a hook (forward or pre-hook) by name.

methods.name: getHook
methods.description: Retrieves a hook by name, throws if not found.

methods.name: hasMethod
methods.description: Checks if a method exists.

methods.name: addStaticMethod
methods.description: Adds a static method to the class.

methods.name: findStaticMethod
methods.description: Finds a static method by name.

methods.name: unsafeRemoveMethod
methods.description: Removes a method unsafely.

methods.name: refine
methods.description: Refines the class type with new attribute types.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new ClassType instance.

methods.name: addAttribute
methods.description: Adds an attribute to the class.

methods.name: unsafeRemoveAttribute
methods.description: Removes an attribute unsafely.

methods.name: unsafeChangeAttributeType
methods.description: Changes the type of an attribute unsafely.

methods.name: addConstant
methods.description: Adds a constant value.

methods.name: getConstant
methods.description: Retrieves a constant by name.

methods.name: getConstant
methods.description: Retrieves a constant by slot index.

methods.name: findConstant
methods.description: Finds a constant by name.

methods.name: unsafeRemoveConstant
methods.description: Removes a constant unsafely.

methods.name: compilation_unit
methods.description: Returns the associated compilation unit.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property by name.

methods.name: addProperty
methods.description: Adds a property with getter and setter functions.

methods.name: findConstantSlot
methods.description: Finds the slot index of a constant by name.

methods.name: getConstantName
methods.description: Gets the name of a constant by slot index.

methods.name: numConstants
methods.description: Returns the number of constants.

methods.name: constantValues
methods.description: Returns a reference to the list of constant values.
